verdict.rationale: The core PlayCanvas Engine is fully open-source on GitHub and can be used standalone via npm/create-playcanvas without any cloud dependency, and plans mention 'Download Apps for Self-hosting.' However, the primary Editor/collaboration platform is explicitly cloud-only ('entire Editor runs in your web browser... automatically saved to the cloud'), and community feedback corroborates that project code/assets must live on PlayCanvas's servers with no easy local dev environment, meaning the full product experience cannot be self-hosted. missing for 10: self-hostable Editor/backend, first-party self-hosted deployment guide, independent confirmation of a fully offline/self-hosted stack.
